contract_term.value: Below 100 MW: the greater of 10 years and 5 years plus the load ramp period; 100 MW or more: the greater of 15 years and 10 years plus the load ramp period. After the term, automatic one-year extensions unless the customer gives written notice at least 24 months before termination

cites.quote: The minimum initial contract term for ESAs below 100 MW will be the greater of (a) 10 years and (b) 5 years plus the load ramp period. The minimum initial contract term for ESAs of 100 MW or more will be the greater of (a) 15 years and (b) 10 years plus the load ramp period.

At the expiration of the contract term, ESAs will be automatically extended for one-year terms unless the customer notifies the Company in writing of its intent to terminate the contract at least 24 months in advance of such termination.

collateral.value: Dedicated Facilities: advance funds equal to the estimated total cost as CIAC within 60 days of the LA. Transmission Network Upgrades: a letter of credit equal to the estimated total cost within 60 days of the ESA, reduced ratably once a year after three consecutive billing months at 75% of full contract demand. Security equal to the liquidated damages for early termination, in cash, letter of credit or parent guarantee, or a combination, as the Company requires

cites.quote: The customer will provide advanced funds equal to the estimated total cost of Dedicated

The customer will provide a deposit in the form of a letter of credit equal to the estimated total cost of transmission network upgrades necessary to serve the customer load (“Network Upgrades”) within 60 days of execution of the ESA.

After the customer meets or exceeds an actual monthly billing demand of 75% of full contract demand for three (3) consecutive billing months, the letter of credit required to cover and secure the costs of the Network Updates will be reduced once per year on a ratable basis over the remaining term of the ESA.

Security Requirements: The customer must provide security equal to the applicable liquidated damages for early termination in the form of cash, letter of credit or parent guarantee, or a combination thereof, as required by the Company in its discretion.

exit_fee.value: Liquidated damages for early termination: 100% of minimum billing demand charges at annual contract demand and Extra Facilities Charges during the notification period, plus the net present value of remaining Extra Facilities Charges, plus 25% of remaining minimum billing demand charges after the notification period. Notification period: below 250 MW 24 months; 250 to 499 MW 36 months; 500 MW or more 48 months. After the 6th anniversary of service, a one-time reduction of up to 20% (no more than 200 MW) without liquidated damages. On early termination the Company draws the network upgrade letter of credit for the remaining net book value

cites.section: Exhibit 1, Liquidated Damages for Early Termination
cites.quote: Liquidated damages for early termination arising from customer notification and/or customer default will be equal to (1) 100% of minimum billing demand charges at the customer’s annual contract demand and Extra Facilities Charges during the applicable notification period, plus (2) the net present value of remaining Extra Facilities Charges under the remaining term of the contract after expiration of the notification period, plus (3) 25% of remaining minimum billing demand charges at the customer’s annual contract demand under the remaining term of the contract after expiration of the notification period.
o Below 250 MW: 24 months o Between 250 MW and 499 MW: 36 months o 500 MW or more: 48 months

cites.section: Exhibit 1, Liquidated Damages for Contract Reduction
cites.quote: After the 6th anniversary of initial provision of service, the customer may provide notice to reduce contract demand by up to 20% but no greater than 200 MW, one time, without incurring liquidated damages.

In the event of early termination pursuant to the terms of the ESA, the Company will draw on the letter of credit to recover the remaining net book value, as of the date of termination, of Network Upgrades as CIAC.

AGENDA: 11/03/26 - Regular Agenda - Post-Hearing Decision - Participation is Limited to Commissioners and Staff
Staff recommends that the Commission deny DEF’s proposed tariff as filed, with leave to refile, on two grounds.

threshold_mw.value: 50 MW: Peak Contract Demand forecast at or above a Monthly Maximum Demand of 50,000 kW of firm load at a single location, including co-located load; sites on the system as of 31 December 2025 not subject to the added requirements

cites.quote: This policy applies to any individual Customer, for either a new or expanded facility, with an aggregate Peak Contract Demand forecast reasonably expected to be equal to or in excess of a Monthly Maximum Demand of fifty thousand (50,000) kilowatts of firm (i.e., not Interruptible or Curtailable) load, at a single location including co-located load, any time during the Minimum Term.
This policy will not impose any additional requirement for customer sites that otherwise meet the Peak Contract Demand requirements and exist on the Company’s system as of December 31, 2025.

min_demand.value: Minimum Demand between 75% and 85% of annual Contract Capacity (contract capacity may be phased in tranches); a Minimum Billing Energy Volume at a projected load factor of no lower than 60%; Billing Demand the higher of the month's maximum demand, 90% of Grid Demand (highest in the last 12 months) or the Minimum Demand. The customer has no more than the Load Ramp Period to reach its first contract demand

cites.quote: Minimum Demand: Minimum Demand shall be between 75% and 85% of the annual Contract Capacity, excluding temporary, construction, bridging and/or commissioning power as agreed to by the Customer and Company.
This minimum volume will be based on the Minimum Demand calculation above assuming a projected load factor, no lower than 60%, as agreed upon.
Billing Demand: Billing Demand shall be the higher of: (a) the Monthly Maximum Demand in the current month, (b) 90% of the Grid Demand, or (c) the Minimum Demand.
Customer will have no more than the Load Ramp Period to reach its first contract demand amount, at which time the minimum monthly bill will be the sum of the following:

contract_term.value: Minimum Term 20 years from permanent service, which may include a Load Ramp Period; termination after service begins needs written notice no later than two years before the termination date

cites.quote: Minimum Term shall be for a period of twenty (20) years, commencing on the date when permanent service is received. This term may include a transitional load period (“Load Ramp Period”).
Once the Customer begins taking service, the Customer shall provide written notice to the Company, no later than two years prior to the requested date of termination of service.

collateral.value: Security Amount equal to a Security Percentage of the applicable termination payment, set by credit review, revised annually; at least 10% where the termination obligation exceeds 100 million USD; in a standby irrevocable letter of credit or cash, a parent guarantee reducing the percentage. CIAC: 100% of the estimated cost to extend service paid in advance, refunded over up to five years as base revenues are collected

cites.quote: The security amount to be provided is a percentage (“Security Percentage”) of the applicable termination payment (“Security Amount”).
All Customers, regardless of credit health, will be assigned a Security Percentage of at least 10% if the Termination Payment Obligation or Termination Fee exceeds $100M.

Customers may provide a parent guarantee from the ultimate parent or corporate affiliate of the Customer, substantially in the form provided as an attachment to the LLCA in order to reduce the Security Percentage.
b. Cash for the full Security Amount.

Company requires Customer to pay 100% of the total estimated costs to extend service in advance. Those payments are refunded over a period of up to five years, less CIAC that would normally be paid by Customer, as base revenues are collected.

exit_fee.value: Termination before full load ramp: the Company's actual costs incurred (Termination Payment Obligation). Termination before the end of the term: a Termination Fee of three years of Minimum Monthly Bills plus the net book value of new facilities, less any unrefunded refundable CIAC

cites.quote: If Customer terminates the LLCA before reaching full load ramp, the Customer must pay Company its actual costs incurred to provide service (“Termination Payment Obligation”).

The Termination Fee is equal to three years of Minimum Monthly Bills plus the net book value of new facilities referenced in section 13.07 below less any refundable portion of the upfront CIAC payment, which has not yet been refunded.

study_timeline.value: Study duration not published. A non-refundable system impact study fee of 150,000 USD (150,000 USD more for updates); the customer must enter an LLCA or a reimbursement agreement within three months of receiving the system impact study

cites.quote: Such Customer shall also pay a non-refundable system impact study fee of $150,000 to support the Company’s initial analysis and engineering costs to determine the investments and upgrades necessary to serve the Customer’s proposed load. Customer shall pay an additional $150,000 for any necessary updates. Customer shall enter into an LLCA or a reimbursement agreement within three months of receipt of the system impact study.

connection_timeline.value: No fixed timeline: service dates follow the customer-requested load ramp in the LLCA, which the Company does not guarantee; service does not begin until the Company has capacity for the Contract Capacity

cites.quote: Company will work diligently to meet Customer’s requested timelines but does not guarantee such timelines can be met.
service to Customers shall not commence until the Company has sufficient capacity to meet the Customer’s Contract Capacity requirements
